_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: CLEAN POP PLAZA gift box. Replaces ChestBody, ChestLid, ChestBand x2, ChestBandLid x2, ChestLock, ChestGlow in buildChest(). Origin on the plaza floor at hub (-24, 0, 40), front (+Y here = Roblox -Z) facing (-14, 0, 20) as today. Box 5.6 x 4.0 x 3.2, lid 6.0 x 4.4, 5.75 tall with the bow.

lidHinge.note: Roblox axes: back top edge of the box. Turn CleanGift_Lid about this line by up to about 100 degrees (top swinging backwards, towards Roblox +Z) to open; or simply lift the lid straight up 2 studs
